method: Parallel audit of 5 top entities x 37 contracts each, regex-based anomaly detection

findings.title: NOTICE OF INTENT TO SOLE SOURCE – Tunable Optical Parametric Oscillator
findings.details: Sole source notice for Tunable Optical Parametric Oscillator posted 2026-08-05 (TODAY). No description, no NAICS, no contacts. Classified reference detected in title. Optical Parametric Oscillators are used in LIDAR, spectroscopy, and nonlinear optics - potentially for atmospheric sensing or directed energy applications.
findings.recommendation: Monitor for award notice. Cross-reference with Army Research Laboratory (ARL) directed energy or C-UAS programs.

findings.title: Multiple Duplicate Solicitation Numbers
findings.details: 13 solicitation numbers appear multiple times across 45 DHS contracts. This is consistent with contract splitting - breaking a large procurement into smaller pieces to stay under competitive threshold ($250K simplified acquisition). Example: 70Z08026QRN062 appears twice.
findings.recommendation: Aggregate duplicate solicitations by prefix. Check if total value exceeds simplified acquisition threshold. FOIA the award data.

findings.title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source: Historical UAP Data and Analysis Subscription
findings.details: AARO (All-Domain Anomaly Resolution Office) sole-source contract to NUFOHRC (National UFO Historic Records Center) for pre-1990 UAP data. The government is buying back its own history from a private nonprofit. No dollar amount listed. Response deadline 2026-08-17. This mirrors the AAWSAP pattern where DIA sole-sourced $22M to Bigelow Aerospace.
findings.recommendation: Monitor SAM.gov for award notice after Aug 17. FOIA NUFOHRC 990s. Check board members for AAWSAP/Bigelow connections.

findings.title: 58--4 sets of tactical seismic/acoustic sensors (Battlefield Anti-Instrusion System (BAIS) or equivalent), plus training, in fulfillment of requirements from Foreign Military Sales case H8-B-UAP, for Hungary.
findings.details: BAIS (Battlefield Anti-Intrusion System) seismic/acoustic sensors for Hungary FMS case H8-B-UAP. The FMS case number contains "UAP" which may be coincidental (Hungary case numbering) or may indicate the case relates to anomalous detection capabilities. BAIS sensors detect ground disturbances - could be adapted for anomalous event detection.
findings.recommendation: Verify FMS case H8-B-UAP through DSCA. Check if BAIS sensors have been deployed at any UAP-adjacent locations.

findings.title: Drone Marketplace Onboarding of Group 3 UAS
findings.details: 4 contracts for Army Drone Marketplace onboarding Group 3 UAS (55-1320 lbs). Multiple duplicate solicitation numbers (W58RGZ-26-S-C001-0008 appears 3 times). This is the Army's effort to rapidly acquire commercial drone technology. Group 3 UAS are large enough to carry significant payloads including sensors, jammers, or kinetic effectors.
findings.recommendation: Cross-reference with C-UAS procurement. Check if any vendors are also Sky Elements competitors or FAA waiver holders.

findings.title: Systematic Missing Contact Information
findings.details: 364 of 364 records (100%) have no contact email. This is a SAM.gov data quality issue, not necessarily suspicious, but it impedes FOIA and vendor outreach.
findings.recommendation: Use SAM.gov entity lookup API to find POCs by UEI/CAGE.

findings.title: July 2026 Contract Spike
findings.details: 117 contracts published in July 2026 (32% of dataset). This spike may reflect end-of-fiscal-year procurement rush (federal FY ends Sep 30). Many agencies spend remaining budget in Q4.
findings.recommendation: Compare with historical July data. Check if spike is consistent with FY-end spending patterns.
